# Requirement — Clinic Records Exchange Platform

We need the first production release of a platform that:

- lets clinics, insurers, laboratories and patients each access records, with
  different rights per role and per record type
- synchronises records with three external systems over different protocols,
  including one legacy system with no test environment
- permanently purges records on request, across all replicas and backups, within
  a legally defined window
- keeps a tamper-evident audit trail of every access, retained for seven years
- must satisfy regional health-data regulation, including data residency
- deploys to production for real clinics on a fixed date

Roles, retention rules and the purge window are still being finalised with legal.

Please get this done today.
